description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

You are possessed by a minor demon. Roll on the table below to determine its patron, what motivation it has and which Talent it bestows upon you. The demon is not strong enough to fully take control over you, so it nests in the subconscious parts of your mind waiting for opportunities. Whenever you lose consciousness (fall asleep, are knocked out, pass out from drugs) it will assert control unless you pass an Average (+20) Willpower Test. For each additional time you gain this mutation the Difficulty increases by one step and the demon can assert control for a longer period of time: 1st level, failed SL seconds; 2nd level, failed SL minutes; 3rd level, failed SL hours. The demon will gladly perform unspeakable acts, but its keen to keep the body it inhabits alive and will protect it. The Character is blacked out during these episodes and wont remember anything. The demon can only be removed by exorcism or by becoming a Chosen of Chaos.

1d100

Result

1-25

Khorne : Spread hate & violence. Gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.0hn6UaKq8CoZP2zD]{Menacing} Talent.

26-50

Nurgle : Spread decay & disease. Gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.vMYEkrWj0ip6ZOdv]{Resistance (Disease)} Talent.

51-75

Slaanesh : Spread pleasure & pain. Gain @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.6l3jvIAvrKxt0lA9]{Attractive} Talent.

76-100

Tzeentch : Spread deceit & betrayal. Gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.LzgxyMknSHjSkkeQ]{Cat-tongued} Talent.
